name: Ollama
description: Ollama's own desktop app, window and backend, built from Ollama v0.35.0 and run inside a VM: chat with models that run on your Mac, pull them from Ollama's registry, optionally sign in to ollama.com for cloud models and web search. Your chats stay in the app's own storage. Runs on the VM's CPUs; the Mac's GPU is an optional, experimental extra.

network.purpose: Ollama's model registry: it tells the app which files make up the model you pull. Nothing about you or your chats is sent.
Ollama's storage on Cloudflare R2: the registry redirects every model download to this host, where the model files are served.
Your Ollama account (sign in, usage), cloud models and web search. Used only when you sign in or pick a cloud model; turn Cloud off in Settings to stop it. Refuse it to use local models only.

host.purpose: Runs models on the Mac's GPU through Vulkan (experimental: the VM gets a paravirtual GPU). Without it, or with the loader's experimental switch off, models run on the VM's CPUs.
